exercise.instruction: Define a class 'Dog' with a String field 'name', a constructor Dog(String n) that sets name, and a method bark() that prints '<name> says woof'. In main, create Dog d = new Dog("Rex") and call d.bark().
hints: Hint 1: class Dog { String name; Dog(String n) { name = n; } void bark() { System.out.println(name + " says woof"); } }
Hint 2: In main: Dog d = new Dog("Rex"); d.bark();

quiz.question: What does 'new' do?
options: Creates an object from a class

quiz.question: What is a constructor?
options: A method that deletes an object
A special method that sets up an object on creation
